name: Multi-Fix & Custom Script Suite
description: Test item featuring multiple independent check/fix commands and several custom task groups in both array and single-object formats.

check.name: Alpha marker present
check.description: Verifies the alpha probe marker inside OS temp directory

check.name: Beta marker present
check.description: Verifies the beta probe marker inside OS temp directory

check.name: Gamma marker present (450ms)
check.description: Simulates a slower check step to observe independent running/pass/fail states

fix.name: Provision alpha marker
fix.description: Creates the alpha marker file independently

fix.name: Provision beta marker
fix.description: Creates the beta marker file independently

fix.name: Provision gamma marker (600ms)
fix.description: Creates the gamma marker file with a short delay for parallel/cancel verification

diagnose-env.name: Inspect marker statuses
diagnose-env.description: Prints presence and timestamps for alpha, beta, and gamma probe files

cleanup-markers.name: Remove alpha & beta markers
cleanup-markers.description: Deletes alpha and beta marker files while keeping gamma intact

simulate-partial-failure.name: Emit sample stderr & exit 1
simulate-partial-failure.description: Tests non-zero exit status and stderr highlighting on a single custom task
